newsitem.title: SPAIN: Repsol retail tranche demand 47 times offer.
newsitem.headline: Repsol retail tranche demand 47 times offer.

text.p: Demand for Spanish energy group Repsol's retail tranche was 47 times the original offer, with 856,642 requests for shares valued at a total 3.56 trillion pesetas, state holding group SEPI said on Friday.
At 1200 GMT, the period to buy shares concluded. On Wednesday, following the close of the New York bourse, SEPI will fix the final share price which cannot exceed 6,327 pesetas.
The governmnet is selling its last 10 percent stake in the energy blue chip this month.
